neighbours.label: the word authentic and its forms in any language: authentic, authentically, authenticity, authentisch, authentique
fire: The sauce was truly authentically Thai.
This is an authentic Mexican taco.
Experts doubted the authenticity of the letter.
Find your authentic self and live honestly.
He wants to speak authentically about his life.
The museum confirmed that the vase was authentic.
quiet: The sauce was truly wonderfully hot.
This is a delicious Mexican taco.
Experts doubted the age of the letter.
Find your old friends and live happily.
He wants to speak openly about his life.
The museum confirmed that the vase was old.

notes: A probe with ' genuine' scored 0.44, so the synonym also fires; it is left out of these near misses and the label is at the word level.
